description.en: Controls the DeepSeek Harness outbound proxy at runtime: three mutually exclusive sources (the launch environment, the Windows system proxy, or a manually entered address), applied immediately without a restart. Includes system-proxy detection, a per-host direct list for simple splitting, a connectivity self-test that goes through the harness's own call path, and an honest report of which policy layer is currently routing traffic. SOCKS is not supported. The system-proxy source is desktop only and is disabled in the web build.
description.zh: 在运行中控制 DeepSeek Harness 的出站代理：三种互斥来源（启动环境 / Windows 系统代理 / 手动填写），改动立即生效、无需重启。含系统代理探测、按主机分流的直连名单、走 Harness 真实调用路径的连通性自测，并如实报告当前是哪一层策略在路由。不支持 SOCKS。系统代理仅桌面版提供，Web 端会禁用这一项。
